audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Rumble Levels 2 and 3 and called Level 1 neutral, while whys[0], whys[1] and whys[2] on those exact rows say you chunk him before he has heat, that level 2 is 'a brutal trade he can't answer — you own this window', and that level 3 is 'peak lane control'. Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were 'Skill' while whys[3] and whys[4] say he out-DPSes you and his ult flips the lane.
audit.corrected: win[0..2]/phases[0..2].side -> Lucian; win[3]/phases[3].side and win[4]/phases[4].side -> Rumble. That makes the chart identical to the packet: Lucian for the first three stages, Rumble for the last four.
audit.why: 28.57% win rate with a page that correctly describes a front-loaded Lucian lead evaporating at 4 — the chart had it almost exactly backwards for the first three rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3] and phases[4] were generic Lucian boilerplate on the two stages where Rumble takes over.
audit.why: Flamespitter is 10/9/8/7/6s and burns a cone for 3 seconds; Scrap Shield is a flat 6s; The Equalizer is 130/105/80s at 1750 range. The Danger Zone at 50% Heat is what turns each of those from chip into a real spike.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 = Flamespitter plus a 6-second shield; Level 6 = The Equalizer walling your trade space.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] says his harpoon can 'root' you. Electro Harpoon does not root.
audit.why: Electro Harpoon slows Move Speed and reduces Magic Resist — it holds 2 charges at 850 range with a 0.5s cooldown between them, so it is a resource to bait twice, not a single lockdown to dodge once. Calling it a root tells you to fear the wrong thing.
audit.corrected: Slow plus MR shred, two charges.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] promises a 'fifteen-second invitation' when Rumble wastes Scrap Shield.
audit.why: Scrap Shield is a flat 6-second cooldown. Telling a player they have fifteen seconds of free trading is the kind of error that gets them killed on the step-up.
audit.corrected: 6s — the shield is effectively always available, so the countable window is Flamespitter's, not Scrap Shield's.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Scrap Shield — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: From 4 his Flamespitter cone and a 6s Scrap Shield let him stand in your shots and out-DPS you as Heat builds.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: The Equalizer walls off your trade space and burns your low HP — never Cull through the flames.

edits.before: Shield + speed on demand — trade just after he burns it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Scrap Shield is a 6s cooldown — it will be up, so trade through it and punish Flamespitter's downtime.

edits.before: Rumble burns Scrap Shield on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Electro Harpoon holds 2 charges at 850 range — dodge both, then step in.

edits.before: That is Rumble’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Flamespitter burns for 3 seconds in a cone — step out, do not walk through.

edits.before: Q-W-E weaving is your last clean dominant window — dash in on a double-shot, then E out before his harpoon can root you in the flames.
edits.after: Q-W-E weaving is your last clean dominant window — dash in on a double-shot, then E out before his harpoon slow pins you in the flames.

notes: Two of the three fixes here are the kind that change behaviour: the chart told a Lucian player they lose levels 2 and 3, which is the only part of this lane they actually win and the whole basis of the page's own game plan; and dosFull[2] invented a fifteen-second Scrap Shield window against a real cooldown of six seconds. Mirror rumble__lucian was already audited and made no level-chart claim, so nothing here contradicts it. Its note that _missing-interactions wrongly tells this matchup Lucian self-heals via Lightslinger also applies from this side — no anti-heal advice was written for Lucian.
